note: spring5-xml: AuditInterceptor extends the HandlerInterceptorAdapter Spring 6 removed → implements HandlerInterceptor (default methods since 5.3) — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|HandlerInterceptorAdapter` (43323914ef)
response:
<analysis>HandlerInterceptorAdapter was removed in Spring Framework 6; HandlerInterceptor has default preHandle / postHandle / afterCompletion since 5.3. The script swaps the import and turns `extends HandlerInterceptorAdapter` into `implements HandlerInterceptor`; the overriding methods stay as they are.</analysis>
<script>
import re

OLD_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.web.servlet.handler.HandlerInterceptorAdapter;"
NEW_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor;"

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = text
        if NEW_IMPORT in new:
            new = new.replace(OLD_IMPORT + "\n", "")
        else:
            new = new.replace(OLD_IMPORT, NEW_IMPORT)
        new = re.sub(r"\bextends\s+HandlerInterceptorAdapter\s+implements\s+", "implements HandlerInterceptor, ", new)
        new = re.sub(r"\bextends\s+HandlerInterceptorAdapter\b", "implements HandlerInterceptor", new)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: HandlerInterceptorAdapter -> implements HandlerInterceptor")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: no HandlerInterceptorAdapter left")
</script>
